related.description: Simple, useful and opinionated CLI package in Go.
Closed-loop application library for Cobra commands  (powerful, ready-to-run and easy to use)
Eliminate Cobra boilerplate: build powerful, feature-rich CLIs declaratively from Go structs.
POSIX-compliant command-line UI (CLI) parser and Hierarchical-configuration operations
Opinionated declarative CLI args, ENV vars and config files
